## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature / improvement

## How I tested
- [ ] Loaded unpacked in **Chrome** and/or **Edge** (`Load unpacked` on the repo or `dist/`)
- [ ] `npm run smoke` passes (or N/A)
- [ ] Manually verified the affected surface (Deck / Grid / The Tape / Calendar / Dock / Settings)

## Checklist
- [ ] No new permissions added (or clearly justified above)
- [ ] Any externally-sourced or user-entered strings rendered to the DOM are **HTML-escaped** (XSS)
- [ ] Third-party network calls stay in the **background service worker**; no remotely-hosted code
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed
- [ ] I have read **CONTRIBUTING.md** and agree to its contribution terms
